attribution.note: Marcus states and endorses the causal explanation in his own words.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves the retrospective profitability assertion and its stated reliability and cost causes.

contract.note: Company-wide net profitability is a fair ordinary reading. The selected first-half window supplies a limited financial snapshot. Missing causal evidence prevents resolution regardless of the profit-measure ambiguity.

evidence.note: Reports first-half operating losses, not net income. It does not establish the claimed reliability or training-inefficiency mechanisms.
Reports cash burn and research costs with an explicit verification limitation. Neither establishes net losses or isolates the asserted causes.

Available before the evaluation cutoff. Improved October paid-user compute margins concern a different period and metric; they neither establish company profitability nor rule out material training and reliability costs.

reviews.rationale: The packet lacks matching net-income evidence and evidence establishing or excluding a material contribution from reliability constraints and the stated data-intensive training mechanism. Operating losses and cash burn cannot establish the full causal claim; improved serving margins do not refute it.
